title: skills/objectstack-query aggregation.md: a zoned date bucket no longer always stays in memory once PostgreSQL buckets it in the database (#33697)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: class a, the `Skills-docs:` debt S2 from the contract-review delta PASS 6936523534 on PR #34530 (card #33697), passed on by area `o2-F`. Dedupe: `aggregation.md timezone`, `zonedDateBucketing`; no open card besides #33697 itself.

reach (read from the file on `main`): `skills/objectstack-query/rules/aggregation.md`, section "Filtered Aggregation (FILTER WHERE)", about lines 122–126, says that a date bucket under a non-UTC `timezone` keeps the whole call in memory. Once PR #34530 merges, a driver declaring `supports.zonedDateBucketing` (PostgreSQL through `driver-sql`) pushes a zoned date bucket down to the database, so the sentence becomes false on PostgreSQL. An author or agent reading the skill would expect an in-memory call and the `aggregationFilter` behaviour that goes with it.

Suggested-grade: p2 · `domain:skills` · `pm:blocked`, Blocked-by #33697

## 维护者速读

- 现象：技能文档写「非 UTC 时区的日期分桶整次调用在内存里算」,#33697 合并后 PostgreSQL 会直接在库里分桶，这句话就不对了。
- 为什么要修：技能是 AI 写应用时读的，写错会让它对性能和过滤行为做出错误判断。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

Rewrite that note: a driver declaring `supports.zonedDateBucketing` (today PostgreSQL via `driver-sql`) buckets a zoned date in the database; on every other driver a zoned date bucket still keeps the whole call in memory. Keep the eval case, or add one, that exercises the sentence.

## Done when

The section matches the driver capability the code reads, and the skill eval for it passes.
